decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, resilient creatures. It focuses on aggressive strategies, utilizing low-cost and efficient creatures such as Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, Brutal Cathar, and Luminarch Aspirant to quickly build a formidable board presence. Support cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Thalia's Lieutenant help to further enhance the strength of these creatures. The deck also includes disruption elements with Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Giant Killer to hinder the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Ossification provides additional value and resilience. The mana base is optimized to ensure consistent access to white mana.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive play and quick damage output using powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bonecrusher Giant. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push to control the board and clear the way for attacks. With a mix of strong creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck looks to overwhelm opponents early in the game and maintain pressure throughout the match.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Llanowar Elves and Wolfwillow Haven to enable powerful green creatures and spells. Devotion to green is key, as cards like Old-Growth Troll and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx benefit from having a high devotion to green. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Cavalier of Thorns and Polukranos Reborn, with Karn, the Great Creator providing utility and Boseiju, Who Endures offering protection for important spells. The goal is to quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of fast mana and strong creatures.

This UW Control deck focuses on countering opponent's spells and utilizing Teferi, Hero of Dominaria's abilities to control the game. It includes a mix of removal spells, card draw, and win conditions like Dream Trawler and Shark Typhoon. The deck also features lands that provide additional utility such as Castle Ardenvale and Field of Ruin. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, outvalue them with card advantage, and eventually win through powerful threats or by decking them out with Narset, Parter of Veils.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game, using efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire to control the battlefield. With the support of powerful creatures like Zurgo Bellstriker and Migloz, Maze Crusher, along with Atarka's Command to pump up the team, this deck aims to finish the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures like Unlucky Witness and Cauldron Familiar to trigger effects from cards such as Mayhem Devil. The deck uses cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building its own board presence.

The primary strategy of this deck is to utilize low-cost spirit creatures with disruptive abilities to apply early pressure on the opponent while also protecting its own creatures with counterspells. By combining aggressive creatures like Spectral Sailor and Spell Queller with cards like Curious Obsession and Geistlight Snare, this deck aims to maintain a tempo advantage over the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of flyers and evasion abilities allows this deck to bypass blockers and deal damage swiftly to close out the game.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and stabilizing the board with powerful threats like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Hullbreaker Horror. The deck utilizes counter spells, removal, and board wipes to control the game, while also having the ability to draw cards and scry with cards like Memory Deluge and Impulse. The mana base is designed to ensure consistency and maximize the deck's potential. The goal is to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and well-timed threats.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy with a combination of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes a mix of big finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Misery's Shadow to seal the deal. With a strong mana base and a mix of removal and threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and decisively.

This Rakdos aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It combines efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize with powerful threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying constant pressure with a mix of creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to close out the game quickly by dealing damage efficiently and controlling the board with a combination of removal and threats.

This deck focuses on aggressively sacrificing creatures to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven to create a loop of sacrificing and dealing damage. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board while maintaining pressure. With the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring, the deck aims to have a consistent and powerful late-game threat that can help secure the win.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects, such as dealing damage to your opponent with Mayhem Devil and gaining value from Cauldron Familiar. By utilizing cards like Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, you can constantly generate value from sacrificing your own creatures. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Claim the Firstborn to steal your opponent's creatures and disrupt their game plan. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to control the board through sacrifice effects and aggressive creatures to overwhelm your opponent.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester with cards like Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, players can deal damage to the opponent and gain valuable resources. Mayhem Devil punishes the opponent for each sacrifice made, while cards like Claim the Firstborn allow for stealing and sacrificing the opponent's creatures. Thoughtseize provides disruption by allowing players to take key cards from the opponent's hand. The deck aims to control the board and quickly close out games with aggressive plays.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain tempo and pressure on the opponent using low-cost Spirit creatures that have disruptive and evasive abilities. By playing aggressively while also using counterspells and removal, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own threats. Cards like Curious Obsession provide card advantage, while Spectral Sailor and Mutavault ensure a steady stream of threats. The mix of aggro and control elements in this Azorius Tempo deck allows for a versatile and efficient gameplay style.

The main focus of this deck is to swarm the field with aggressive spirit creatures, while maintaining tempo and disrupting the opponent's plays. By utilizing low-cost and evasive creatures like Spectral Sailor and Shacklegeist, along with anthem effects from Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. Mausoleum Wanderer and Rattlechains provide disruption against spells, while Curious Obsession and Combat Research help to draw into more threats. The inclusion of Snow-Covered Islands and Faceless Haven allows for potential snow synergies and extra creature threats.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to manipulate the game through counterspells, card advantage, and removal spells to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The deck utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils, along with versatile cards like Shark Typhoon and Memory Deluge to generate card advantage and token threats. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion provides additional synergy and utility to the deck, enhancing its control elements and overall game plan.
